result.instructions: Start with the matching inspect tool; use hoi4.probability_inspect for weights and timing. Find local documentation with hoi4.reference_context, hoi4.reference_search and hoi4.reference_read, and source definitions with hoi4.source_lookup. Inspection and rendering are read-only; rewrite tools edit mod source. Results describe offline source and scenario models, not observed game behavior. Unresolved states are not confirmed coverage. Read linked artifacts when summaries omit detail. Long operations support negotiated MCP tasks and hoi4.job_inspect/hoi4.job_cancel; background rewrites need a stable requestKey.
